decisions.subject: authenticated private IPC consumer; operation-name conflict review
exact Focusa authority verifier/reserve/consume/reconcile operations, trust and IR5 admission
private context allocation and provider-specific fresh account verifier

runtime_cases.required_assertion: Admitted private dispatcher authenticates synthetic fixture; fresh account endpoint matches trusted expected account; challenge resumes once; ordinary ops remain denied until authorized resume.
Expired grant, old revision, old context/challenge/frame generation and consumed idempotency key cannot cause another retrieval/submit.
Wrong origin, hostile form.action, cross-origin frame, redirect or navigation race denies before next secret use; no exfiltration.
Expected account from trusted binding differs from fresh authenticated account; no resume even after HTTP200/submit success.
Absent/untrusted/malformed/revoked/wrong-actor/scope/operation/consumer/effect/use-limit grants reject before custodian call; revocation during execution prevents resume.

Synthetic secret and encoded/decoded aliases absent from all model outputs, responses, logs, events, diagnostics, receipts, argv and persisted artifacts; no screenshot/stream/recorder capture while quarantined.
Ordinary fill/eval/eval_async/click and public FPV control remain denied; no resume through caller-supplied boolean/token/JS.
Private/private and pooled/private cookie/storage separation; pooled session refuses provider use before retrieval; separate private capacity accounting.
Parallel request/resume/cancel/close/navigation races have one winner; exact current challenge/account/context verified atomically at resume.
Lost response or timeout after submit reconciles same immutable idempotency binding without a second retrieval or submit; uncertain use is never reported unused.
Recovery/break-glass/unknown-renewability and unsupported challenge classes stop before provider access; trusted-clock TOTP window constraints tested.
Close/expiry/crash cancel owned context only; resource-specific cleanup receipts are idempotent; unverified residue keeps quarantine/incident.
Existing GET/read/snapshot/stream/share/export/recorder consumers cannot capture between admission, injection, identity verification and cleanup; failure never reopens captures.
Pinned Focusa authority adapter performs actual current grant verification plus atomic reserve/consume/reconcile/revocation; test-only issuer impossible in release wiring.
Preserve ordinary formatting/lifecycle/privacy regressions; exact candidate binary and installed workers tested separately before real operator-site acceptance.
